pedido.description: side view, facing right, short stocky robust horse inspired by the Crioulo breed, low and wide, deep thick chest, short thick muscular neck, short strong sturdy legs, full thick mane, compact heavy body, clearly shorter and wider than an average horse, standing still horse, all four legs clearly visible and separated, the far legs offset from the near legs with a gap between every leg, no overlapping legs, no rider, no saddle, long straight flowing mane and tail, pure red (#ff0000) coat with dark red (#800000) shading, bright green (#00ff00) mane and tail with dark green (#008000) shading, blue (#0000ff) hooves and muzzle, black outline, flat colors, no gradients, no anti-aliasing
